body:
Flagged by AI reviewer in PR #2093.

## Problem

`machine/machine-sense.sh` builds `folders[]` from `du -x --max-depth=1` on each `MACHINE_SENSE_FOLDER_ROOTS` entry (default `/opt/ai`), so every entry is a direct child of a root: `{root: "/opt/ai", name: "lxd", ...}`. The box's own folder lives deeper, at `/opt/ai/lxd/containers/disinto-nomad-box`, so it never appears in `folders[]` unless the host adds that path to `MACHINE_SENSE_FOLDER_ROOTS` by hand.

`disk_owner_line()` (`supervisor/preflight.sh`, #2077) looks for the entry named `${MACHINE_BOX_NAME:-disinto-nomad-box}` and otherwise falls back to the `root == "/opt/ai"`, `name == "lxd"` upper bound. On the real layout that fallback fires: the `lxd` entry is most of the used volume, `share` reads high, and the owner is `box` — so `disk_pct_gt` still fires and `disk-pressure.sh` still prunes Docker against space the box cannot free, exactly the situation #2077 was written to stop. The suppression only engages when the host is configured with a deeper root.

Concrete failure mode: the gate is inert in production until someone hand-edits the host env, and nothing in the repo says so — the acceptance fixtures all use a deep `root`, so the fallback path is never exercised.

## Suggested fix

Have `machine/install.sh` (or the systemd unit) set `MACHINE_SENSE_FOLDER_ROOTS="/opt/ai /opt/ai/lxd/containers"` by default and document the requirement in `machine/README.md`; add an acceptance fixture that exercises the `lxd` upper-bound fallback.

---
*Auto-created from AI review*

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `machine/install.sh` (or the machine systemd unit) sets `MACHINE_SENSE_FOLDER_ROOTS="/opt/ai /opt/ai/lxd/containers"` by default so the box footprint (`${MACHINE_BOX_NAME:-disinto-nomad-box}`) appears in `folders[]` without hand-edited host env
- [ ] `machine/README.md` documents the deep-root requirement for the box-footprint match
- [ ] an acceptance fixture exercises the `/opt/ai` + `lxd` upper-bound fallback in `disk_owner_line` (supervisor/preflight.sh) and asserts the owner line is emitted from the fallback entry
- [ ] `tests/acceptance/issue-2094.sh` passes in CI

## Affected files
- machine/machine-sense.sh
- machine/install.sh
- machine/README.md
- supervisor/preflight.sh
- tests/acceptance/issue-2094.sh (new)

Flagged by AI reviewer in PR #2087.

## Problem

`ensure_ops_repo()` (`lib/formula-session.sh:205`) is documented — in `lib/AGENTS.md`, in its own comment, and now in `supervisor/AGENTS.md` (#2069) — as **never fatal**: every git step is wrapped and the function ends with `return 0`. But the call to `migrate_ops_repo "$ops_root" "${PRIMARY_BRANCH}"` at `lib/formula-session.sh:224` is unguarded, and `migrate_ops_repo` (in `lib/ops-setup.sh`, which itself sets `set -euo pipefail`) can fail inside its own body: `cd "$ops_root" || return 1`, and `git add -A` (which is not wrapped in `if ! ...; then`). Under the caller's `set -e`, a failing `git add -A` exits the whole organ run before `return 0` is ever reached.

Reproduced hermetically on the PR branch: a bare origin + clone, with a stray `/.git/index.lock` (the same state a concurrent organ run produces on the shared `/home/agent/repos/disinto-ops` clone), then `ensure_ops_repo` in a `set -euo pipefail` shell:

    fatal: Unable to create '<clone>/.git/index.lock': File exists.
    Another git process seems to be running in this repository ...
    (script exits, rc=128 — 'after ensure_ops_repo' never prints)

This matters now that the supervisor calls `ensure_ops_repo` every 20-minute tick (#2069), alongside the gardener and the planner: three organs fetching/pulling/committing the same clone raise the odds of an index-lock collision, and the collision would abort a supervisor tick — the exact failure mode the #1653 contract was written to prevent.

## Suggested fix

Guard the migration call and its internal git ops: `migrate_ops_repo "$ops_root" "${PRIMARY_BRANCH}" || log "WARNING: ops repo migration failed"; return 0`, and wrap `git add -A` in `if ! git add -A 2>/dev/null; then echo ... >&2; fi` inside `migrate_ops_repo`. An acceptance test could assert `ensure_ops_repo` returns 0 when `.git/index.lock` exists in the clone.

---
*Auto-created from AI review*

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `ensure_ops_repo` returns 0 even when `migrate_ops_repo` fails — the migration call is guarded (`migrate_ops_repo "$ops_root" "${PRIMARY_BRANCH}" || log "WARNING: ops repo migration failed"`)
- [ ] `git add -A` inside `migrate_ops_repo` is wrapped so a failure (e.g. a stray `.git/index.lock` from a concurrent organ run) logs and does not abort the run under `set -e`
- [ ] an acceptance test asserts `ensure_ops_repo` returns 0 with a stray `.git/index.lock` in the ops clone
- [ ] `tests/acceptance/issue-2088.sh` passes in CI

## Affected files
- lib/formula-session.sh
- lib/ops-setup.sh
- tests/acceptance/issue-2088.sh (new)
